// D_<address> globals the decomp defines but configs/USA/sym.*.txt never
// names. Without these the RetroAchievements address map lets the preceding
// symbol's inferred span swallow them, and the set reads unrelated memory --
// which is why the whole .bss ranking subsegment (0x800C48A0) read 0 and the
// star achievements could never fire.
//
// The name encodes the address, so nothing here is guessed. Names that do not
// resolve at runtime are skipped by the loader.
